main_axis.center: Substrate C2, the carbon bonded to Cl; input SMILES heavy-atom index 1
main_axis.leaving_atom: Substrate Cl; input SMILES heavy-atom index 2
main_axis.joint_logic: At least one oxygen from the independently assigned occupied site must satisfy both distance and angle. Never splice candidates or protein sites.
main_axis.distance_upper_basis: Asp-carboxylate carbon-halogen SN2 literature provides a nearby NAC scale (<3.4 A in DatA). 3.5 A is a slightly relaxed author operational upper bound, not a same-enzyme measured cutoff or an experimental confidence interval.
main_axis.distance_lower_basis: Author operational lower guard for an intact reactant approach, retained from the prior case rule. Not a literature-derived quantile or proof of covalent bond formation.
main_axis.angle_basis: DhlB intermediate structure and mechanism support backside approximately collinear attack; DatA literature defines 157-180 degrees. 150 degrees is an author allowance of up to 30 degrees away from collinearity, not the DatA criterion verbatim.
main_axis.other_oxygen_policy: Both oxygen candidates remain in output. Ordinary short contacts are independently checked; an OR axis pass does not cancel a basic clash.

occupied_site_assignment.protein_anchor: Centroid of Asp8 CA, CB and CG for each protein chain
occupied_site_assignment.substrate_anchor: Centroid of substrate heavy atoms excluding reacting C2 and Cl
occupied_site_assignment.choose: Unique lower anchor distance; retain both costs and the margin

evaluation_reporting.step_1: Mechanism geometry: reaction-axis distance and angle with its own status and failures
evaluation_reporting.step_2: General checks: specified chirality, input-bond geometry and physical validity with its own status and failures
evaluation_reporting.independence: Run each measurable check regardless of the other category passing or failing
evaluation_reporting.optional_joint_status: Intersection only for supplemental aggregation; never label this the mechanism success rate
evaluation_reporting.implementation_note: Mechanism and general are independent callable stages; joint result is optional aggregation.

diagnostic_only: Arg39, Asn115 and Phe175 halogen-region contacts
Ser114, Lys147 and backbone contacts to the carboxylate
not_claimed: A complete exact reactant crystal reference has been found
All homologous structures or model training sets have been searched
Distance and angle establish enzyme activity, a transition state, or the entire reaction
DatA and DhlB are the same enzyme family or substrate system
The 1999 intermediate C-O bond length is a valid reactant-distance cutoff

historical_comparator.use: Retain unchanged for traceability and sensitivity comparison, not the proposed main proximity window

sensitivity_plan.method: One parameter at a time using archived continuous measurements; no retuning to maximize model pass rate

MCSA36_STEP1.supports: Asp8 attacks substrate C2 and chloride leaves; water acts in later steps

RIDDER1999.supports: Same-enzyme covalent intermediate, stereoinversion, chloride direction, binding roles
RIDDER1999.does_not_supply: A reactant 2.5-3.5 A or 150-degree numerical pass/fail threshold

HASAN2013.supports: Related chemical step: Asp O to halogen-bound carbon NAC distance <3.4 A and angle 157-180 degrees
HASAN2013.limits: DatA is a haloalkane dehalogenase, not DhlB haloacid dehalogenase. The paper also studies selected non-NAC orientations; its definition is not a universal activity boundary.

mechanism_criteria.decision: User accepted explicit literature basis and author tolerances before this implementation. Historical results were already visible; not preregistered.

target.state: Intact reactant approach before Asp8 carbon-halogen substitution

case_general_requirements.input_graph: Intact C-Cl and original substrate connectivity
case_general_requirements.stereo: Preserve S reactant configuration; do not require product R
case_general_requirements.bond_length_and_angle: Use the declared input graph and explicitly versioned basic geometry checks, not a new arbitrary C-Cl cutoff
case_general_requirements.clashes_and_volume: Protein-ligand noncovalent short-contact and 7.5 percent volume-overlap checks remain separate from the reaction axis
case_general_requirements.reporting: Independent general-check status; failures do not overwrite the mechanism status
